$comment: Provenance for the vendored canonical Gap-2 gate. This repo COPY-OWNS the runner and SHARES the contract vectors, per shared/catalog/fleet-duplication-share-vs-copy-ruling-2026-08-13.md section 2 Q2: fleet CI runs GitHub Actions on ubuntu-latest after a single-repo checkout, so agent-settings/shared/ does not exist at enforcement time and a cross-repo path dependency would be unreachable in CI. The register row for this standard says 'an adopting repo invokes the shared file rather than copying it', which contradicts that ruling; the contradiction is tracked, and this repo follows the ruling because the ruling is the one that survives a single-repo checkout.
driftCheck: sha256sum scripts/captured-surfaces/derive-captured-surfaces.mjs -- compare against canonicalPath at canonicalCommit. A divergence means this copy has drifted from the fleet gate and must be re-vendored or the divergence justified here.
relationshipToTheRepoOwnGate: scripts/derive-captured-surfaces.ts is NOT superseded. It carries mission-control-kanban#147's sourceDigest staleness check, which the canonical gate does not have, so replacing it would be a regression. Both run in `npm test`: the repo gate owns staleness, the canonical gate owns router fidelity (private folders, intercepting routes, @slot, %5F) and the liveness contract.
